verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's coding-agent template ships `sandbox0-browser`, Google Chrome Stable and Playwright CLI for browser automation. It also includes TigerVNC, the Openbox window manager and a built-in noVNC viewer, giving a full graphical desktop inside the sandbox. Custom public or private images can extend the environment further. missing for 10: a dedicated browser/desktop documentation page (the evidence is a single template mention), explicit confirmation of headless-mode usage and resource requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
